title: The Two-Tower Signal
ending: Together you decoded the old route signal. Your expedition is recorded.

stages.title: The missing word

stations.clue: The weather vane shows a SUN. Tell the decoder exactly what you see.
Archive rule: append RISE to the observers symbol. Submit the joined word.

stages.result: The first signal is decoded. Follow the second pair of stations.

stages.title: The second beacon

stations.clue: The beacon flashes BLUE. Tell your partner its color.
The ledger pairs BLUE with TIDE and RED with ASH. Submit the matching word.

stages.result: The towers answer in harmony. The old message is complete.
